# Anatomy toolkit

Unmodified files from https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy at commit
`e6600ffc4e8e6620eeb45bf49bcdbd5e4b84163f` (MIT, © 2026 Ryan).

Only the SVG toolkit, its geometry audit dependencies and the inline helper are
vendored. The build embeds the complete MIT notice in each standalone HTML.
Upstream verification scripts can be run from a checkout of this exact commit;
they use Node built-ins and a locally installed Chrome. No runtime CDN or npm
package is required by the published page.
